assessments.comment: Independent inspection of frozen cohort remodnav-e3c6253bced7, manifest SHA256 e3c6253bced7d959cd59873c3d49d166bf5793906bcdf65e49e265076d215499. Scope includes numerical results, figures and manuscript plus explicitly linked computational components. No network calls, payload acquisition, scientific execution or container build was performed. Cached source, metadata, reachable history and read-only Git probes support judgments; no independent reproduction is claimed. Binary/annex payloads, image layers and some style/figure assets are absent from the package. The local-only raw-source ancestor is disclosed but not treated as essential to consuming the distributed scoped inputs. Historical exit-0 run records are not new validation of results. Signing-key verification unavailable locally; no route found in object. Native assessment has two unanswered criteria and remains provisional; the inspection report itself is complete.
